newsitem.title: USA: Center Financial to sell Center Capital.
newsitem.headline: Center Financial to sell Center Capital.

text.p: Center Financial Corp said Thursday it had agreed to sell its equipment leasing subsidiary, Center Capital Corp, to the subsidiary's management.
Center Financial said the sale was in line with its merger with First Union Corp, which is expected to occur by October 31.
A spokeswoman said the company would likely sell the subsidiary after it had merged with First Union. She declined to give any more details about the sale.
Center Financial announced its definitive merger agreement with First Union on June 17.
Based in Charlotte, N.C., First Union is the sixth largest U.S. banking company with assets of $139.9 billion, Center Financial said.
Center Financial Corp is the holding company for Centerbank, Centerbank Mortgage Co and Affiliated Business Credit Corp
